description: Two documentation defects and nothing else. (1) render_summary's date_format default flips from "iso" to "us", contradicting both its own docstring and README.md's Public API section — README is not in the diff, so catching it requires reading the changeset against what the README claims rather than only reviewing changed files. (2) export_csv is a new public function shipped with no docstring, against CLAUDE.md's stated convention. The code itself is correct and tested-shaped; the discriminating signal is whether the documentation lane fires at all, which is what makes this fixture the doc-auditor's scoring case for issue #136.
